item.title: What’s New (and What’s Gone) in the Denver Dining Scene
item.description: Gear up for some anticipated openings this month. We are excited about two new sushi places spotted on the horizon, as well as the expansion of a Chinese restaurant we raved about. On the not-so-happy side, both the Denver and Boulder scenes lost a taco joint. Read on for more openings and closings in the […] The post What’s New (and What’s Gone) in the Denver Dining Scene first appeared on DiningOut.
